raw_recipe.headline: Apple Dip
raw_recipe.description: Apple dip made with plain or flavored cream cheese, brown sugar, and vanilla — this childhood favorite is ready to enjoy in just 5 minutes!
raw_recipe.name: Apple Dip

recipeInstructions.text: Stir cream cheese, brown sugar, and vanilla extract together until sugar has dissolved and mixture is smooth. Serve with fresh apple slices.

review.reviewBody: Was a great hit!! Remember, if you cut the apples before hand, you can leave them in water and lemon juice to keep from turning brown!

This dip is darn good!!! Not only for apples, but also with graham crackers, animal crackers, bananas, and as a topping for vanilla ice cream. I did modify it a tad. I doubled the recipe and also added a 7oz jar of Kraft Jet-Puffed Marshmallow Creme. Use an electric mixer to blend the ingredients and the end result will be smooth and DELISH!!!

We make this dip for almost every function we go to, although we do not make it with vanilla. For those that didn't like it you must be doing it wrong. Although pretty hard to mess this one up. We usually have apples left over after all the dip is gone. And despite what some reviewers have found for us, light cream cheese works just fine for this recipe. We start with a half cup of brown sugar then adjust to taste for sweetness. Another twist we added was to put skor toffee bits in for an added sugar kick. But make sure add these in at the last second before serving as the toffee bits can become soggy if added to far in advance. Best part is that it is simple and quick to make and can be made up at a moments notice if the first batch runs out too quickly. Everyone likes it so much that we get in trouble if we don't bring it.

Super Easy and Sweet Snack! I paired this sweet snack with green apples for flavor and color. Additionally, I used pure vanilla from Mexico. After mixing and mixing with a spoon I eventually used the hand blender with the whisk attachment to smooth out and blend the cream cheese more. This would be great with a few dashes of cinnamon and a bit of chopped pistachios. I would also recommend ¼ cup brown sugar vs. ½.

Easy and delicious! Softened cream cheese in microwave at 30% power, then whipped ingredients together with a wire whisk. Also added a dash of cinnamon. I dipped the cut apples in lemon-lime soda before arranging on the tray around the bowl of dip. The citric acid in the soda keeps the apples looking great (w/o tasting like lemon!)!

Have been making this dip for years, always a hit and very versatile. I use room temp reduced fat cream cheese, less sugar as recipe calls for-don't like it too sweet. I also always use a food processor, mini prep to mix- gives a very smooth result and breaks down sugar granules. I like to top with chopped peanuts to give a taste of caramel apples when dipping apples. Thanks for bringing back an old fall fav!

Fantastic! We made this for a quick addition to our fruit platter. Delicious, quick, easy, and I had all the ingredients on hand- makes this five stars! Quick tip- to hasten the softening process of the cream cheese. Open the brick of cream cheese, then slice it into eight pieces, separate the pieces on the foil wrapper and leave on the counter for 20 minutes.

Super yummy, quick and easy to make. I used low-fat cream cheese(not fat free)and had it at room temp and it mixed up just fine. I didn't pack the brown sugar like you typically do with brown sugar. I gave it 4 stars because while it was good, I felt like it was lacking something. I ended up adding 1/3 C. vanilla Greek yogurt and it made it just right. Everyone loved it, even the picky eaters. I served it with apples and grapes. I will make again.

My daughter-in-law had a simular recipe as above but she added an 
8oz. bag of Heath English Toffee Bits (not chocolate) and 1/2 C. Sugar and 1 Tea. of Vanilla and increased the brown sugar to 3/4 C. All I can say is DELICIOUS......

This is great tasting! I am on a diet during the holidays. My twist? I used fat free cream cheese, Splenda brown sugar, vanilla and threw in a 5 ounce container of Oikos Salted Carmel Greek yogurt. It was the first dip finished!

This is so good! I can eat this by the spoonful. Delicious recipe with ingredients I always have on hand. I used Neufchâtel cheese (which is the lite version of cream cheese). Will make this often. Thanks for the recipe.
Took this to a Christmas party and it was not received very well.
Love this recipe! It's adds healthy tasty-by-themselves apples but also tickles my sweet tooth and isn't near as bad as the other sweet treats I enjoy.
Made the recipe as is. I did use a hand mixer to mix ingredients together. Made it a bit fluffier. Used Granny Smith apples. Kids loved it. Thanks for a quick, easy and delicious recipe!
Huge hit with the 2 year old and adults alike! Good stuff!! Thanks for sharing!!
I liked the apple dip. It comes together quickly. I used a hand held mixer to combine the ingredients because a spoon didn’t cut it. Next time I will add cinnamon as a garnish.
My daughter and I had fun making this delicious dip. It was super quick and easy. We love it with apple slices, graham crakers, and animal cookies.
This is quite good as a fruit dip, but I also can see this spread on a morning bagel or English muffin. Only 3 ingredients and packed with flavor, delish! Garnished with a sprinkle of cinnamon.
A really delicious apple dip for so few ingredients! 7-9-2011 Delicious!
I loved it it was very good nice sweet treat for kids
